take: Podia groups text, embed, quiz, coaching, and file lesson types under one New lesson menu in the course outline.
observed: Open New lesson; choose Add files; an uploading PDF row appears in the section and then resolves to a completed file with size.
limits: Three sampled frames do not show the file chooser, link entry, learner result, or every actual click.

take: Teachable separates content types in one Add content palette, then unifies device, cloud, and URL sources within the PDF Viewer dialog.
observed: Open Add content; choose PDF Viewer; choose local/cloud/URL source; the sampled alternatives enter a URL or select a hosted PDF and upload; the PDF then renders inline in the lesson.
limits: Seven sampled frames appear to cover alternative source branches, not one required linear flow; no learner view is shown.

take: Teachable's Add PDF dialog consolidates local upload, several cloud providers, and URL input inside lesson editing.
observed: The modal allows selecting or dragging a PDF, shows provider icons including Google Drive, Dropbox, and OneDrive, and includes a link-source icon; copy says a student download link can be included.
limits: Single frame; it does not show opening, completion, embeds beyond PDF, or learner presentation.

take: A nominal Teachable digital-product setup frame places File upload and Redirect to URL together, but is not visibly course-lesson authoring.
observed: Step 4/7, Add your content, offers radio choices File upload and Redirect to URL; File upload is selected with an Upload button and accepted file types.
limits: Single frame with no visible product branding; no embed choice, completed action, course structure, or learner result. Qualify or relocate outside course-authoring evidence.

take: Dropbox Dash combines search/paste-link, existing-source selection, and Upload in one Add sources modal for chat context.
observed: The modal shows Search or paste a file link, one existing PDF source, Upload, and Done over a Dash chat.
limits: Single frame; this is source selection for Dash chat, not a course attachment chooser, and no completed action is shown.

take: Gumroad's digital-product Content canvas places rich-text/link tools, a closed Insert menu, and page creation together.
observed: The Web Design Course content tab shows a formatting toolbar with link controls, Insert, and + Page above an existing linked phrase.
limits: Single frame; the closed Insert menu does not establish upload or embed options, and Gumroad is a digital-product analogue rather than course-specific evidence.

take: Udemy shows learner access to lesson downloads, not how an instructor adds upload, link, or embed material.
observed: A mobile learner player has Lectures, Downloads, and More tabs; Downloads lists video lessons with download icons.
limits: Single learner-side frame with no authoring controls. Relocate to Q6 or exclude from Q1.
